\caption{Cost at fixed list prices. (a,b)~Total cost of each run against its agent steps, counting every
agent and summarization request; open marks are failed runs, and dashed lines mark constant cost per 100
steps in CNY. (c)~Cost per step of L divided by that of S, A, or K after repricing the same requests with
only the cached-input price changed, pooling each policy's runs and the L runs on the same tasks; above 1,
compaction is cheaper per step. Marks show each provider's actual price.}
\label{fig:cost}
\end{figure*}
